offering_description.value: Designs and builds towboats for wakesurfing, wakeboarding and waterskiing, along with pontoon boats for recreational boaters. It assembles the boats in U.S. factories and sells them through independent marine dealers.

primary_products.value: Inboard watersports towboats; pontoon boats; replacement parts and accessories

customer_segment.value: B2B: Independent marine dealers; B2C: Recreational boat buyers, including watersports enthusiasts and families

revenue_model.value: product sales: New boats, replacement parts and accessories sold through dealers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Builds complete boats from materials and purchased components for independent marine dealers

geography_served.value: global: Primarily the United States and Canada, with dealers in other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: Watersports towboats and recreational pontoon boats

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Independent marine dealerships in North America and overseas

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Recreational boat construction and fuel systems are subject to U.S. Coast Guard safety standards and EPA emissions rules.

notes: The current scope of the pontoon business is uncertain.
